'''Harthusa''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] based on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Deysum III]]. Although cunning, Harthusa's cowardice was evident. He resided within a luxurious [[Harthusa's dome|domed apartment]] where he entertained females of all races. He owned the yacht known as ''[[Harthusa's Pride]]''. Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Kentara]] came into Harthusa's possession, and the Devaronian [[Slavery/Legends|sold]] him at auction to [[Quintarus Returyl]], a representative of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]]. Unknown to Harthusa was the fact that Kentara was a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]; an Alliance team on Deysum III witnessed the sale and broke the Wookiee out of Harthusa's [[slave camp]] the same night, making their escape in the ''Harthusa's Pride''.
